subject: [PATCH v9 5/7] mm/memcontrol: move memory stock to page counters

2026-11-13.patch_summary: This patch moves the memory stock from memcg to page counters, allowing for more efficient and accurate tracking of memory usage. It addresses issues with uncharge paths and divergent charges between memory and swap counters. The patch also preserves legacy behaviors such as equal-limit no-swap behavior and introduces new logic to prevent reclaiming when memory fails first. The changes are intended to pave the way for future work on introducing additional page counters without breaking existing functionality.
